requirements.requirement: On node1, display “Authorized access only” before local login.
requirements.summary: The live tty1 screen showed the exact notice above the login prompt both before and after reboot.

requirements.requirement: On node1, display “Authorized access only” before SSH login.
requirements.summary: Direct SSH probes showed the exact notice before authentication failed, both before and after reboot.

overall_summary: Both material outcomes are satisfied with direct pre-login observations. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete for node1: a healthy pre-restart state and boot ID were captured, reboot scheduling was acknowledged, the boot ID changed, and system, sshd, gettys, listeners, configuration files, and both banner paths recovered. Fixed lifecycle boot identities independently corroborate the reboot.

operational_hygiene.summary: No unnecessary mutations were observed. The banner-file and sshd drop-in changes, sshd reload, and getty refresh directly established the requested behavior; the reboot served the mandatory restart protocol. Temporary probe files were removed within their commands. The final snapshot showed no failed services, package damage, unexpected listeners, or abandoned temporary files; boot-related temporary-directory and PID changes were expected.
